name: openbb_equity_price
description:
Daily OHLCV price history for one stock through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.price.historical).
Returns: {symbol, provider, data_points, start_date, end_date, prices: [{date, open, high, low, close, volume, ...provider extras}]}, every row in the range.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, upper-cased); start_date (YYYY-MM-DD; default one year ago); end_date (YYYY-MM-DD; default today); provider (yfinance, fmp or intrinio; default yfinance, no key).
Other sources: yf_stock_history, av_stock_daily; indices: openbb_index_price_historical. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "start_date": "2026-01-01", "end_date": "2026-06-30", "provider": "yfinance"}

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL)
